newsitem.title: DUBAI: U.S. Navy rescues crew from sinking Iranian dhow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Navy rescues crew from sinking Iranian dhow.

text.p: A U.S. naval vessel on Wednesday rescued nine crew members from a sinking Iranian cargo boat in the central Gulf, a U.S. Navy statement said.

The U.S. cruiser Antietam received a distress signal from the Soroosh, a 110-tonne traditional wooden dhow, which began flooding en route to Iran from Qatar, the statement from the U.S. Naval Forces Central Command in the Gulf said.
The Iranian crew was evacuated to the Antietam, where they were given food and clothing, it added.
The cruiser initially tried to tow the Soroosh to port, but high wind, rough seas and uncontrollable flooding caused the tow line to part and the dhow had to be abandoned, the Navy said.
The Antietam was on its way to Qatar's capital Doha with the rescued crew members, it said.
